channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Missiles fired at U.S. frigate in Strait of Hormuz, claims Iranian media
item.description: Iranian media claimed missiles were fired at a U. S. frigate in the Strait of Hormuz, but U. S. Central Command said no U. S. Navy ships were struck. The incident occurred on May 4, with Iran asserting it had forced the warship to turn back.

item.title: Rubio to Visit Rome, Vatican Says, After Trump’s Feud With Pope and Meloni
item.description: U. S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will visit Rome after President Trump's feud with Pope Francis and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. Trump had criticized the Pope and then turned on Meloni for defending him.

item.title: Iran says it turns back US warship from Strait of Hormuz, US CENTCOM denies missile strike
item.description: Iran said it turned back a U. S. warship from the Strait of Hormuz, but U. S. Central Command denied a missile strike. The incident followed Trump's warning that the U. S. would intervene if ships were stranded in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: 'Low' risk to public of hantavirus after cruise ship deaths, WHO says
item.description: The World Health Organization said the risk of hantavirus to the public is low after two deaths on a cruise ship. The WHO advised against panic or travel restrictions. "The risk to the wider public remains low.

item.title: World Must Hold U.S. Responsible for Making Strait of Hormuz Unsafe
item.description: Iran urged the world to hold the U. S. responsible for making the Strait of Hormuz unsafe. The call came as tensions rose in the region. Iran: World Must Hold U. S.

item.title: Pakistan Foreign Minister discusses regional situation with Iranian counterpart
item.description: Pakistan Foreign Minister Bilawal Bhutto Zardari discussed the regional situation with Iranian counterpart Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to constructive engagement and dialogue for peaceful resolution. They emphasized diplomacy as the path to lasting peace.

item.title: Iran says it fired missiles at US warship to prevent it entering Hormuz
item.description: Iran fired two missiles at a US Navy destroyer to prevent it from entering the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state media. The missiles struck the warship. Iranian state media says two missiles have struck a US navy destroyer to prevent it entering the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Pakistan Says It Helped Transfer Iranian Crew From Ship That U.S. Seized
item.description: Pakistan helped transfer an Iranian crew from a US-seized ship back to Iran. Describing the transfer of the crew from the MV Touska cargo ship back to Iran as a ‘confidence-building measure’ between U. S.

item.title: Global equity funds attract inflows for sixth week on earnings optimism
item.description: Global equity funds attracted inflows for the sixth consecutive week, driven by optimism over corporate earnings. Investors poured money into stocks. Global equity funds attract inflows for sixth week on earnings optimism.

item.title: Amazon opens up its logistics network to other businesses
item.description: Amazon opened its logistics network to other businesses, expanding its services. The move increases Amazon's presence in the market. Amazon opens up its logistics network to other businesses.

item.title: Drone Hits a Moscow High-Rise Days Before a Major Military Parade
item.description: A drone hit a Moscow high-rise building, breaching air defenses in the Russian capital, days before a major military parade. Ukraine has been expanding its long-range strikes. Air defenses in the Russian capital were breached as Ukraine expands long-range strikes.

item.title: Trump officials threaten UN budget cuts as US pushes ‘trade over aid’ agenda
item.description: US officials have threatened to cut the UN budget if the organization does not adopt a 'trade over aid' agenda, a shift in policy that prioritizes economic interests over humanitarian assistance. The move is part of a broader US push to reorient international relations.

item.title: NATO chief says Europeans have ‘gotten the message’ from Trump on defence
item.description: NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg says European countries have "gotten the message" from US President Trump on defence spending, following Trump's criticism of some NATO members for not contributing enough to the alliance's military efforts.

item.title: Canada Declares Khalistani Extremists "National Security Threat"
item.description: Canada has designated Khalistani extremist groups as a national security threat, citing their involvement in separatist activities. The move follows similar designations by New Delhi, which has outlawed these groups as terrorist organizations.

item.title: Ukrainian drone hits upmarket Moscow high-rise ahead of Victory Day celebrations
item.description: A Ukrainian drone struck a high-rise building in Moscow ahead of Victory Day celebrations, as the Kremlin prepares to hold a scaled-back military parade. The attack comes amid ongoing tensions between Russia and Ukraine.

item.title: Israeli gunfire disables teenagers in West Bank
item.description: Israeli gunfire has left several teenagers injured in the occupied West Bank, where soldiers have killed or maimed many young people, according to Al Jazeera. The incident has sparked concerns about the impact of military action on local civilians.

item.title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: A suspected virus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship has resulted in three deaths. The World Health Organization confirmed one case of hantavirus infection and is investigating five more suspected cases.

item.title: Dubai airport passenger traffic drops 66% over war
item.description: Dubai International Airport's passenger traffic dropped 66% due to the war. The airport was targeted by drones as the UAE faced Iran's retaliation for U. S.-Israeli strikes. Dubai International was targeted several times by drones as the oil-rich UAE bore the brunt of Iran's retaliation for U. S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: What’s happening on day 66 as Trump announces Hormuz mission?
item.description: U. S. President Trump ordered a new mission in the Strait of Hormuz. This came after Iran said it received a U. S. response to its peace proposal. What’s happening on day 66 as Trump announces Hormuz mission?

item.title: With World Distracted by Iran War, Israeli Settlers Intensify Attacks in West Bank
item.description: Israeli settlers intensified attacks in the West Bank amid the distraction of the Iran war. Israel's military officials urged the government to intervene as violence against Palestinians surged. Israel has failed to arrest a wave of violence against Palestinians, prompting military officials to urge the government to intervene.
